title: aes-128/aes-192/aes-256, 4 rounds: Expected differential probability bound [PSS+02]

target.description: Four-round source AES SPN under independently uniform round subkeys; final linear layer omitted as a coordinate convention. Not the standard master-key schedule distribution.

evidence.locator: CompletePDF1–16/printed176–191; PDF2 independent-key model; PDF7–14 Theorems1–3 and support-count proofs; PDF15 Theorem4, r>=5 and explicit approximate coefficient.
evidence.interpretation: Corrects an ingestion-added <=1.06 inequality to the exact original formula and approximate decimal. This is not a source erratum or an attack improvement.

limitations: The bound is averaged over independent uniform round subkeys. Its decimal coefficient is approximate; native source formula is preserved.

property.statement: The source bounds the maximum expected differential probability by A(p)=4*p^19+6*p^18+4*p^17+p^16 for 0<p<=2^-3. At p=2^-6 the exact formula is1.0639801025390625*2^-96; the paper writes approximately1.06*2^-96, not a strict inequality with coefficient1.06.
property.quantifier: Maximum over nontrivial input/output masks or differences, with probability averaged over independently uniform round keys; not a per-fixed-master-key guarantee.
property.scope: AES128-bit SPN layer structure, independent uniform round keys. The4rbound extends symbolically to r>=5 in the source model.
